metadata.title: Logo & Philosophy
metadata.description: The meaning behind the BIShare mark — two opposing arrows meeting at a single point of light — and the principles the product is built on.

hero.title: One mark, four meanings
hero.subtitle: Two opposing arrows meeting at a single point of light — sharing that is two-way, direct, and yours.

core.quote: “Bi” means two. True sharing is always two-way — giving and receiving at once. Two arrows pointing opposite ways are the heart of the name BIShare.

mark.title: The meaning of each element
mark.sub: It is not a refresh icon — it is two exchange arrows meeting at a single point of light.

pillars.title: Reciprocity
pillars.desc: Perfect 180° rotational symmetry: there is no primary sender or receiver. Both devices are equal — each one gives and takes. This is the “Bi”.

pillars.title: Direct link
pillars.desc: The glowing node in the middle is the point where two devices shake hands directly. No middleman on the data path.

pillars.title: Speed
pillars.desc: Sharp diagonals and crisp arrowheads convey motion — instant, near-wire-speed transfers on the local network.

pillars.title: Private & safe
pillars.desc: A tight, self-contained composition: data stays between the two points. Deep blue and indigo signal trust and the depth of privacy.

notes.text: Rotate the mark a half-turn and it is identical — visual proof of two-way equality.
Both arrows sit parallel on a 45° tilt — dynamic yet calm.
Corner curves follow Apple's superellipse, so it sits naturally among premium icons.
Generous padding keeps the mark breathing at the smallest sizes.

palette.title: The icon palette
palette.sub: The four colors that live inside the mark itself. The product interface uses its own light and dark token sets — the same blue family, tuned separately for contrast.

tokens.body: In the UI, brand blue is a theme token — <mono>#3B82F6</mono> on dark, <mono>#2563EB</mono> on light — so text and controls keep AA contrast in both themes. The icon palette never dictates interface color.

principles.title: The mark is a promise
principles.sub: The same ideas in the logo shape every engineering decision.

items.title: Local-first
items.desc: If two devices can talk directly, they should — the shortest path is the fastest and most private. When they can't, a secure link carries the file instead. Local speed, remote reach.

items.title: Encrypted, always
items.desc: AES-256-GCM end to end, on every transfer. Not a setting. Not a premium tier. The default, because it should be.

items.title: No audience
items.desc: No tracking, no ads, no data resale. A file passing between two people should have exactly two interested parties.
